text:
deploy-bot: Release 4762 -> HOLD. config-parity-check failed for chart `service-a` values: key `featureFlags.enable_cache` type mismatch between staging and prod. staging: "true" (string), prod: true (boolean). Promotion blocked.

Alex K: Ugh, type coercion again. How does the app parse that value? Is "true" treated as truthy?

Maria S: App uses strict YAML parsing at startup (go-yaml). quoted string stays string -> not parsed as bool. So staging winds up disabling cache.

Samir O: Saw a related flake last night (cache unexpectedly off). Options:
- Patch staging values to boolean (fast)
- Modify chart to normalize types (safer for future)
- Pin release and postpone until change window

Priya R: We have the 30m change window in 20m. If we can patch staging and run a quick canary smoke, we can still push. Otherwise pin.

Alex K: Prefer minimal blast radius. Patch staging now, smoke run, then promote. Who can push the change?

Maria S: I can patch staging now. Command:

```bash
helm upgrade service-a ./charts/service-a \
  --namespace service-a \
  --set featureFlags.enable_cache=true --reuse-values
```

Then run the canary job:

```bash
kubectl -n service-a run canary-smoke --image=alpine --rm -it -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sf http://service-a.canary/health || exit 1"
```

Samir O: After smoke, can we have deploy-bot re-run parity-check? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: parity-check queued. Will re-evaluate after 1 min.

Alex K: Also update release notes about schema expectation (featureFlags.enable_cache must be boolean). Add a quick note in the changelog and PROD runbook.

Priya R: I'll add to release notes and tag the ticket. If parity-check fails again, we'll pin.

Samir O: TL;DR: patch staging -> smoke -> re-run parity -> promote if green. :thumbsup:

Maria S: Patch applied, logs show rollout started. Testing now.

deploy-bot: parity-check: PASS. No further type mismatches detected.

Priya R: Canary smoke passed. Ready to promote. Scheduling promotion in 5m within change window.

Alex K: Great, promote and monitor tokenized latency and cache hit rate dashboards.

release-bot: Promotion started. Notifying oncall and posting release notes.

Samir O: Monitoring... will call if anything spikes.

Maria S: All clear so far. Cache hit rate back to expected.

Alex K: Thanks team. We'll follow up in post-release notes about adding a lint step to CI to catch Helm value types.
